big_case.notes: While the underlying subject—federal appellate bar discipline for AI-hallucinated citations and procedural due process notice under In re Ruffalo and FRAP 46/47(b)—has salience for the legal profession given the Ninth Circuit's published opinion, this petition was a fact-bound challenge to one attorney's six-month suspension with no genuine circuit split, and the Court denied certiorari without dissent after a single conference following the Solicitor General's waiver.
